result.rationale: The dialog only resets state in the explicit Cancel button handler (setMultiEmailValue([""]); setIsInvalidEmail(false)) and on mutation success. The Dialog's onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog} just closes without resetting isInvalidEmail or multiEmailValue, so the error banner and stale emails persist when the dialog is reopened via overlay/escape, and isInvalidEmail is not cleared on successful submit either.

judged_text: AddGuestsDialog never resets isInvalidEmail on successful submit or when dismissed via overlay/escape (onOpenChange), so the error banner persists on reopen; the email list is likewise not reset on overlay dismissal

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation in `handleAdd`, but it is never set back to `false` on a successful mutation (`onSuccess` only closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue`). Also, the `Dialog` uses `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}`, so dismissing via overlay click/escape only toggles `isOpenDialog` and does not reset either `isInvalidEmail` or `multiEmailValue`. Therefore, after an invalid submission (or any stateful input), closing via overlay/escape and reopening will show the error banner and/or previous emails, matching the finding.
